verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say it offers "APIs, SDKs" for building custom apps and integrations, alongside a code-first apps framework, programmatic agent control from your own code, and a GraphQL API backed by a published OpenAPI spec and llms.txt. The SDK claim itself is a single generic mention, so the depth of official SDK support is unproven. Missing for 10: named official SDK packages and supported languages, SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
